'''Multiplayer''' support in [[Matcha Flavoured]] was added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]] and extended in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2]], largely by the community contributor Linkershim.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2}}</ref> The developer designed the pack with "a small group of friends playing together" in mind rather than large servers.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=I made this imagining a small group of friends playing together.}}</ref>

== Per-player systems ==
* '''Hearts''': each player's maximum health and minimum hearts are stored per player. Deaths and milestone advancements only affect the player concerned. Before 1.12.2, heart loss was tracked per world.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/heart_container/hpdown.mcfunction}}</ref> One of the chat messages for lowered minimum hearts ("Armies gather beneath the Earth...") is sent to all players.
* '''Difficulty''' is a world setting. On Normal, the first player whose minimum hearts fall to 5 switches the whole world to Hard.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/heart_container/decrease_minimum_hearts.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Difficulty]].
* '''Ender Dragon''': each player who kills the dragon for the first time earns a [[Divine Favor|divine favor]], even if the first killer is offline, and the [[Surface|safe surface]] applies to everyone.
* '''Joining players''': every second, the pack checks for players who have not been set up for the current version. New players get their scoreboards, and players from older versions have recipe unlocks and reward advancements reset.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/player_update_check_loop.mcfunction}}</ref> Keep inventory is set when a new player joins.
* Equipment effects such as bloodrage, [[Anemos]], electrum and adamant apply only to the player concerned since fixes in 1.12.1-alpha. In 1.12.2-beta the [[Wither effect]]'s heart timer is still shared: each second a player is withered, every online player's count goes up. <ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/wither_effect/check_wither_timer.mcfunction}}</ref> It is listed on [[Known bugs]], and an upcoming update makes it per player (see History).

== Sleeping ==
{{Main|Sleeping}}
Vanilla sleep skipping is disabled (<code>players_sleeping_percentage</code> is 200). Instead, while anyone sleeps, time advances by (sleeping players ÷ players in the overworld)² × 300 ticks every tick, and the action bar shows how many players are sleeping. A player who goes to bed at night wakes in the morning; sleeping in the day skips half a day.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/sleeping/calculate_sleep_rate.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/sleeping/calculate_sleep_duration.mcfunction}}</ref> This dynamic sleep was written by milo256.

== Known issues ==
* On Purpur servers keep inventory is handled per dimension and has to be set manually in each.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>
* 1.12 fixed severe lag caused by electrum, adamant and shakudo armor on servers.
